# clickup_folders (Data Source)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `space_id` (Number)

### Optional

- `archived` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `folders` (Attributes List) The Folders in the Space. Subfolders are included in this flat list alongside top-level Folders, each with a `parent_folder` field identifying the Folder it is nested inside of. This endpoint does not nest them; to get a Folder's subfolder tree, use [Get Folder](#tag/Folders/operation/GetFolder) with `include_subfolders=true`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--folders))

<a id="nestedatt--folders"></a>
### Nested Schema for `folders`

Read-Only:

- `archived` (Boolean) Whether the Folder is archived.
- `hidden` (Boolean)
- `id` (String)
- `lists` (List of String)
- `name` (String)
- `orderindex` (Number)
- `override_statuses` (Boolean)
- `parent_folder` (String) ID of the parent Folder if this Folder is a subfolder. Only present when the Folder is nested inside another Folder.
- `space` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--folders--space))
- `statuses` (Attributes List) Statuses defined on this Folder. Only populated when `override_statuses` is `true`. A Folder that inherits its statuses returns an empty array here; its effective statuses are those of its nearest ancestor Folder that overrides them, or of the Space when no ancestor does. To get the resolved statuses for a Folder, request it with [Get Folder](#tag/Folders/operation/GetFolder). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--folders--statuses))
- `task_count` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--folders--space"></a>
### Nested Schema for `folders.space`

Read-Only:

- `access` (Boolean)
- `id` (String)
- `name` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--folders--statuses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `folders.statuses`

Read-Only:

- `color` (String) Hex color code for the status.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the status. Not returned on the Create Folder response.
- `orderindex` (Number) Position of the status within its status group.
- `status` (String) Name of the status.
- `type` (String) Type of the status (`open`, `custom`, `closed`, or `done`).
